name: Shiranami Sato
source:
Sex: Female
Occupation: Houseguest
Age: 17 years old

A mysterious girl currently lodging with [url=/c164208]Shinobu Wakamura[/url], a local Kameshima magnate.
[spoiler]She became immortal after eating the flesh of a mermaid at some point in the past.
She was originally a maidservant working at the Bureau of Onmyo during the Heian period 800 years prior, where she was forced to eat mermaid flesh by [url=/c164767]Taira no Tomoshige[/url].[/spoiler]
* * *
Roughly three months ago, Sato suddenly arrived on Kameshima claiming that she was the child of a relative of the Wakamuras. She showed no sign of attending school or doing any sort of work, instead spending her days holed up in the Wakamura household, leading many islanders to wonder just who she is and what she's doing there.
Those who know about Wakamura's high-interest moneylending behind the scenes speculate that she might be the daughter of one of his borrowers, sent to work as a domestic servant to pay off a debt, but Sato herself is extremely easygoing and doesn't seem to be bothered by the endless rumors.
A huge television fan, she spends much of her spare time glued to the set in the Wakamura household, with her most recent obsessions being soap operas and two-hour thrillers. However, she isn't all that fond of period dramas.
She is good friends with [url=/c163969]Tsukasa Awao[/url], who is close to her in age, and the two can often be seen enjoying themselves wandering the island together.

[From in-game profile]

[spoiler]Sato's true identity is Osato of Kusawa, and she is both the mythical [url=https://www.bunka.pref.mie.lg.jp/minwa/chusei/ano/index.htm]Yao Bikuni[/url] of Ano Town from the Heian period and the historical [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初音姫]Princess Hatsune[/url] from the Sengoku period.
Her true age is 817, but her body remains that of a 17 year old girl.[/spoiler]
